about: Run step commands for the detached launcher (scratchpad launch_suite.py ITER SEED [holdout]), migration delta R01 (owner decision D1). Each command is the argument list after the python interpreter, run in order with cwd = the repo; placeholders: {iter} (the iteration), {seed} (its seed), {para} (the paraphrase, iteration mod 3: 0 = design.json, 1 and 2 = paraphrases.json entries). commands: the train run on the iteration's wording, the regression set (no paraphrases), then the stub-controller train run on the same wording (the authority probe: no LLM, never judged), then the target set (--target: T01, Robin's own SPD flat-pedal adapter, no paraphrases; judged like the regression set, never counted as train or held-out). holdout_commands: the isolated held-out run on the same wording. See loop/RUN.md section 3.
